153 of the 163 academics were found in Scopus.
The publication window came back with 4237 papers.
8 papers were added that the university tag had missed.
584 were thrown out because no author on them printed an Al Ain University address.
3939 author rows are faculty, 678 are students or outside faculty.

Full co-author lists cover 1291 of the 4245 papers. On the other 2954, faculty are counted from their Scopus author IDs, but students and outside co-authors are not known — Elsevier does not serve co-author lists to these keys.
62 people printed an AAU address but are not on the roster. They are waiting on the Roster screen.
